items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: my sister had a good time house... I told Lucy... Lucy say, 'Sippie, you got to have enemies.'

ctx.x: You must have been plenty sad when you sang that song "Trouble Everywhere I Go."

Well, I'll tell you, at home in Houston, my sister had a good time house, used to have a lot of girls -- we had a lot ______ and a lot of girls used to come around our house and we used to play cards and they used to drink ______ and talk and drink and you know, dance and carry on like that thing and everytime you'd turn around, the law was coming there ______ and I would get so mad, I'd say, "How come the law keeps coming to Lucy's house?" You know. But (unintelligible) when I was living in Chicago, I say…
That song "Murder ________ Crime," what did you mean by that?
